Russia targets Starlink and Ukraine's infrastructure amid ongoing conflict

Russia has reportedly deployed jamming devices to disrupt Elon Musk's Starlink satellite internet systems in Ukraine, aiming to counter drone operations. Simultaneously, Russia conducted missile and drone attacks on Kyiv and other Ukrainian facilities, including an arms industry plant. Ukraine has also engaged in offensive actions, striking Russian oil tankers and a refinery.
